page.overview:
Who is Entebe?

Captain Entebe was a female Starfleet officer who served during the late 24th century.

In 2371, she was the commander of the . Towards the end of that year, her starship was studying protoplanetary masses in the Helaspont Nebula, near the Federation-Tzenkethi border.

After the received a distress call from the Federation colony on Barisa Prime that was abruptly cut-off, he was left to assume that a war had broken out. En route to Barisa Prime, Sisko had Kira Nerys locate any other starships in the sector, when she located the Ulysses. Sisko then had Lieutenant Jadzia Dax attempt to contact Entebe for assistance, only to discover that the Defiants communications system had been compromised. ()
